title: Which Learning Theory Is It?
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: AI-Native Schools
description: Classify eight classroom scenarios as constructivism, social constructivism, constructionism, or social constructionism.

learningObjectives: The learner will classify eight classroom scenarios as constructivism, social constructivism, constructionism, or social constructionism, correctly placing at least seven of eight on the first attempt.
prerequisites: Constructivism, social constructivism, zone of proximal development, constructionism, and social constructionism, from the section "How Students Learn: Four Theories" in Chapter 13

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Commit an answer, get feedback with the reason, and review what was missed
keyQuestions: Is a helper or a group involved?
commonMisconceptions: Constructivism and constructionism are the same
Any group activity is social constructivism
Building something alone is not learning by building
assessmentOpportunities: Are constructivism and constructionism the same?
Is every group activity social constructivism?
A student builds a model bridge alone and improves it after a test. Which theory?

controls.name: Choice buttons
controls.description: commit an answer. A wrong first answer gives a hint and lets you choose again; only the first answer counts.

controls.name: Show definitions
controls.description: opens or closes the reference table. Reading it is exploration, not evidence.

controls.name: Next
controls.description: moves to the next item after feedback. On the results screen, Previous missed and Next missed step through what you missed.

controls.name: Play again
controls.description: starts a practice run with the items reshuffled. Practice runs do not change the first-run score.
